title: Kubernetes operator
statement: The system shall provide a Kubernetes operator that brings a declared 3-node cluster to a ready, serving state within 10 minutes of the cluster resource being applied.
rationale: PO decision: Kubernetes operator in addition to bare metal/VMs.

acceptance_criteria.text: On each of the 3 most recent Kubernetes minor releases, applying a 3-node cluster resource yields a cluster that accepts authenticated GQL reads and writes within 10 minutes.
Changing the declared node count from 3 to 5 adds nodes and rebalances replicas with zero failed client requests.
Changing the declared version performs a rolling upgrade that meets REQ-0021 acceptance criteria.
